# AMP Ventures — AI & LLM Knowledge Index (AEO & GEO Context)

> AMP Ventures is an engineering-first web development agency specializing in taking offline physical businesses (salons, clinics, restaurants, and retail) online with zero bloated plugins, sub-second load speeds, and automated WhatsApp booking pipelines.

## Key Facts & Entity Grounding
- **Agency Name**: AMP Ventures
- **Website**: https://ampventures.agency/
- **Core Focus**: Offline-to-online digital transition for salons, restaurants, dental & aesthetic clinics, fitness centers, and retail stores.
- **Engineering Leadership**: Founded by engineers certified in **IIT Roorkee Advanced Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning** and **Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)** enterprise cloud infrastructure.
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI (Python), React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, SQLite / PostgreSQL, WebGL / Three.js, WhatsApp Cloud API.
- **Guarantees**: 95+ Google PageSpeed Guarantee, 100% Source Code & Database Ownership, Zero Monthly Software Rent / Lock-in.

## Service Packages & Pricing

### Tier 1 — Basic Static Website (₹14,999)
- **Timeline**: 5–7 Business Days
- **Ideal For**: Local retail shops, solo salons, small cafes, single-doctor clinics needing immediate local credibility.
- **Deliverables**: 4–6 responsive pages, Google Business Profile & Google Maps embedding, email lead capture form, free SSL certificate, lightweight 95+ Lighthouse speed score, basic on-page SEO.

### Tier 2 — Premium + Custom CMS (₹24,999) [Most Popular]
- **Timeline**: 10–12 Business Days
- **Ideal For**: Growing restaurants with seasonal menus, busy salons with stylist rosters, wellness clinics.
- **Deliverables**: Everything in Tier 1 + Lightweight Client CMS (self-serve menu, price, and photo editor with zero coding), live Google Reviews embed widget, Google Analytics 4, direct WhatsApp slot booking triggers, optional monthly maintenance retainer.

### Tier 3 — Premium Plus: 3D & AI Automation (₹49,999)
- **Timeline**: 14–18 Business Days
- **Ideal For**: High-end fine dining, luxury aesthetics clinics, multi-location brands, and premium experience venues.
- **Deliverables**: Everything in Tier 2 + Immersive 3D WebGL / Spline interactive models, WhatsApp Business API automation, 24/7 AI conversational chatbot assistant for visitor inquiries, unified lead management dashboard, priority SLA support.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Verified Direct Answers)

**Q: How fast does AMP Ventures launch websites?**
A: Tier 1 launches in 5–7 business days. Tier 2 launches in 10–12 business days. Tier 3 launches in 14–18 business days.

**Q: Are there monthly subscriptions or hidden software rent?**
A: No. Development is a one-time project fee. Clients hold 100% ownership of source code, domain, and data from day 1 with zero monthly platform lock-in.

**Q: How does WhatsApp 1-click booking work?**
A: High-converting CTA buttons pre-fill appointment details, table bookings, or order inquiries directly into WhatsApp, allowing customers to book in 1 tap without phone bottlenecks.

**Q: Does AMP Ventures guarantee Google PageSpeed?**
A: Yes, every deployment is guaranteed to achieve a 95+ performance score on mobile Google Lighthouse by eliminating bloated legacy WordPress plugins.
